note: Tokens the app adds to Bugra for a data-heavy desktop app. Each is listed for the owner in docs/design/ADDED.md and can be moved into the Bugra artifact. Values derive from existing Bugra tokens.

size.name: row-h
size.usage: Inventory table row height (dense desktop list). (added)

size.name: statusbar-h
size.usage: Height of the status bar at the bottom of the window. (added)

size.name: sidebar-w
size.usage: Width of the sidebar with navigation and categories. (added)

size.name: panel-w
size.usage: Width of the detail panel that opens beside the table. (added)

size.name: icon-ui
size.usage: Default UI icon size in toolbars and rows. (added)

size.name: icon-category
size.usage: Category and subcategory icons in the sidebar. (added)

size.name: dialog-w
size.usage: Width of form dialogs (Bugra's own dialog is 420px for questions). (added)

size.name: dialog-w-wide
size.usage: Width of the import review and diff dialogs. (added)
